concept.title: Operating turn signals and lane change signals

keywords.indexterm: lighting operating turn signals and lane change signals
operating turn signals and lane change signals

conbody.p: The vehicle must be in the POWER ON position or the DRIVE READY indicator must be on for the turn signals to operate.

li.p: Move the lever up or down (1) to activate the turn signals.
The green turn signal indicators on the instrument panel () show which side of turn signal is operating.
The turn signals will cancel automatically after a turn. If the indicator continues to flash, manually return the lever to the OFF position.
Move the lever slightly to position (2) and hold it to signal a lane change.
The lever will return to the OFF position when released.
If the turn signal indicator stays on without flashing or flashes abnormally, one of the turn signal lamps may be malfunctioning and should be inspected and replaced as necessary.
